author: Sun
name_in_asr: 新井驛, 廣顯驛, 烏山驛 (瓜州提)
asr_identification: the first three posts of the Fifth Road (第五道) from Guazhou to Yizhou, in Changle county, Guazhou; Xinjing 227 li 200 bu NE of Shazhou
evidence: P.2005 (沙州都督府圖經, c. 700): three posts run by Guazhou; Xinjing set up by edict; the road switched to the Shuogan road in 692 and back to the Fifth Road in 695, when ten posts were ordered on it (Guazhou to run three, Shazhou four). Edition and translation by Sun from the manuscript.
quote: 右，在州東北二百卄七里二百步。瓜州常樂界。
note: the posts post-date 629 (678–695); Li Zhengyu (2006, not read) equates the five beacons with these posts. On P.2005's own distances Xinjing lies 104 km from Shazhou at the posts' scale, at the Shule near An-hsi (route/README §11)

author: Sun
asr_identification: the fourth post of the Fifth Road, set up in 678 'in the Moheyan desert of the Fifth Road'; 69 li 260 bu N of Wushan, 64 li 80 bu S of the Fifth post
evidence: Shuangquan moved from the Shuogan road and placed on the Fifth Road in the Moheyan in 678; distance from Shazhou 477 li 160 bu on the manuscript (Gallica scan; Sun reads 260 bu), against 446–450 li from the neighbouring entries (511 li 40 bu less 64 or 60 li 80 bu, both readings in the manuscript): the document's own figure is c. 30 li out.
quote: 唐儀鳳三年閏十月，奉/19 敕移矟竿道，就第五道莫賀延磧
note: for the Tang administration the Moheyan began by the fourth post; the Life puts it beyond the Wild Horse Spring, 100 li past the fourth beacon

author: Sun
name_in_asr: 第五驛, 冷泉驛, 胡桐驛, 赤崖驛
asr_identification: the Fifth post (511 li 40 bu from Shazhou), Lengquan, Hutong, and Chiya on the border of Rouyuan county, Yizhou (Yiwu), 80 li beyond Hutong
evidence: The posts beyond the fourth: 64 li 80 bu, 68 li 30 bu, 84 li and 80 li; Chiya at 743 li from Shazhou on the corrected chain; Fifth post to Lengquan 68 li 40 bu (卌步 on the manuscript in both entries; Sun reads 卅); Lengquan's 579 li 170 bu agrees with its neighbours within 100 bu.
quote: 北去伊州柔遠縣界赤崖驛八十里
note: the official road from Guazhou to Yizhou, at c. 0.45 km per li between posts
